name: auth-header
author: ChicAndUnique
title: Authorization 请求头
description: 下载时自动为匹配的站点补上 Authorization（或自定义）请求头

settings.name: authorization
settings.title: 请求头的值
settings.description: 完整的头部值，例如 Bearer eyJhbGciOi... 或 Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz

settings.name: hosts
settings.title: 生效域名
settings.description: 逗号分隔，支持 *.example.com 通配；留空表示对所有 http(s) 下载生效

settings.name: headerName
settings.title: 请求头名称
settings.description: 默认 Authorization，也可以改成 X-Auth-Token 之类

settings.name: overwrite
settings.title: 覆盖已有值
settings.description: 开启后，即使任务本身已带有该请求头也会被替换
